en: The Philippine eagle can grow up to one meter tall and boast a massive wingspan of up to two meters.
The original 1898 Philippine Declaration of Independence was written entirely in Spanish, not in Tagalog or any native language.
The Philippine Supreme Court consists of exactly fifteen justices, comprising one Chief Justice and fourteen associate justices.
National hero Jose Rizal was a brilliant polymath who could speak twenty-two different languages, including ancient Latin and Greek.
The Sama-Bajau people possess genetically larger spleens, allowing them to hold their breath and dive much deeper underwater.
The Philippines features over one hundred eighty distinct languages, making it one of the most linguistically diverse nations globally.
Bacolod's MassKara Festival features dancers wearing giant, smiling masks to show community resilience during a 1980s economic crisis.
Pediatrician Fe del Mundo invented a makeshift bamboo incubator to help premature babies survive in rural Philippine areas.
Juan Luna's massive masterpiece Spoliarium measures over seven meters wide and four meters tall, taking eight months to paint.
The traditional concept of bayanihan literally involved an entire community physically carrying a nipa hut to a new location.
The Philippine Constitution grants every citizen the fundamental right to a balanced and healthful ecology in harmony with nature.
The Philippines is actually composed of 7,641 islands, which is over five hundred more than the old 7,107 count.
